detailed_descriptions.en: Make spectacular moments happen with the Planet Coaster 2: Parades pack! Conduct a concerto of celebration in the biggest Planet Coaster 2 pack to date! Create extravagant parades with colour, movement and excitement lining every street. Turn your plazas into bustling, vibrant centrepieces which offer the perfect welcome using new Small Town scenery, and say 'Hayo!' to a charming new Entertainer. Cue the Fireworks! Spectacular Parades For the first time ever in the Planet Coaster series create your very own pageant of parades! Use blueprints to get started or craft your floats from scratch with over 250 float scenery pieces! Parades are endlessly adjustable and can be filled with playful colours, charming shapes, and glowing scenery pieces. Set parade attendants to walk next to parades and choose your favourite Entertainers to wave from the floats and lead the procession through your park streets. As the floats roll by, guests will flock to the streets waving Entertainer flags, glowing wands and taking in the spectacle. Schedule the perfect parade by planning what time the procession begins and how often they take place. Create a custom track for your parade that loops around your park or go for a open ended layout winding its way through your park. Parades can even be paused so guests have a moment to take in all the detail on your state of the art floats. Will you set them to run every hour to bring energy throughout the day, or instead, end your park's opening hours with an extravagant celebration? Top it all off with an astounding pyrotechnics display with 19 dazzling new fireworks! Small Town Scenery Use over 200 new Small Town scenery pieces to create plazas for your park with ornate brickwork facades and nostalgic shop fronts. Barbershop quartet animatronics serenade passers by, while hand-painted signage adds warmth and personality. Around every corner, the gentle rhythm of everyday life unfolds. Give your plaza an extra level of realism. Set up speakers with ambient sounds to bring the streets to life with the sounds of: A Busy Bakery Barbershop Cosy Room Classic Car Engine Ice Cream Parlour Piano Lesson Small Town Office Small Town Street 2 Small Town music tracks Five Spectacular Rides Alongside the Parades, five all-new attractions roll into town. Soaring coasters delivering sky high views and pulse-racing twists, two junior-friendly flat rides deliver excitement for the whole family, and an iconic transport trolley gets your guests from A to B in style. With ready-to-use blueprints and customisation options, you have the freedom to shape unforgettable experiences your way. HPC - Buzzard: Soar on a thrilling single-rail coaster! Brave guests will experience tight turns, high-speed drops, and heart-pounding inversions in open-air single-seat cars. V&N – Narrow Drop: Let your guests experience breath-taking views before being plunged down an intense vertical drop they won’t forget. Jumpin’ Disc: Spin into high-speed excitement! This ride spins around while hydraulic arms bounce riders in chaotic movements, your guests will be feeling intense G-forces and jaw-dropping weightless moments. Little Dipper: Even the smallest adventurers can enjoy all the fun of a drop tower! Gentle rises and mini drops give younger guests a safe thrill. Electric Trolley Transport Ride: Let your guests enjoy the sights with a quaint trolley ride around your park inspired by vintage streetcar design. Entertainer Meet Small Town’s cheerful Mayor Pipwhistle, a twirling bundle of whimsy and warm welcomes! With a tip of their hat, confetti showers down on your park's paths, delighting townsfolk and visitors alike. Whether greeting guests at the town square or joining parades, Mayor Pipwhistle brings energy, colour, and a playful sense of joy and wonder to any plaza. New Music It wouldn't be a parade without some exciting music that will keep your guests humming all day - 6 upbeat jazzy music tracks are included in the Parades Pack!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Make spectacular moments happen with the Planet Coaster 2: Parades pack!

Conduct a concerto of celebration in the biggest Planet Coaster 2 pack to date! Create extravagant parades with colour, movement and excitement lining every street. Turn your plazas into bustling, vibrant centrepieces which offer the perfect welcome using new Small Town scenery, and say 'Hayo!' to a charming new Entertainer. Cue the Fireworks!

Spectacular Parades

For the first time ever in the Planet Coaster series create your very own pageant of parades! Use blueprints to get started or craft your floats from scratch with over 250 float scenery pieces! Parades are endlessly adjustable and can be filled with playful colours, charming shapes, and glowing scenery pieces. Set parade attendants to walk next to parades and choose your favourite Entertainers to wave from the floats and lead the procession through your park streets. As the floats roll by, guests will flock to the streets waving Entertainer flags, glowing wands and taking in the spectacle.

Schedule the perfect parade by planning what time the procession begins and how often they take place. Create a custom track for your parade that loops around your park or go for a open ended layout winding its way through your park. Parades can even be paused so guests have a moment to take in all the detail on your state of the art floats. Will you set them to run every hour to bring energy throughout the day, or instead, end your park's opening hours with an extravagant celebration? Top it all off with an astounding pyrotechnics display with 19 dazzling new fireworks!

Small Town Scenery 

Use over 200 new Small Town scenery pieces to create plazas for your park with ornate brickwork facades and nostalgic shop fronts. Barbershop quartet animatronics serenade passers by, while hand-painted signage adds warmth and personality. Around every corner, the gentle rhythm of everyday life unfolds. 

Give your plaza an extra level of realism. Set up speakers with ambient sounds to bring the streets to life with the sounds of:

  • A Busy Bakery

  • Barbershop 

  • Cosy Room 

  • Classic Car Engine 

  • Ice Cream Parlour 

  • Piano Lesson 

  • Small Town Office 

  • Small Town Street 

  • 2 Small Town music tracks

Five Spectacular Rides

Alongside the Parades, five all-new attractions roll into town. Soaring coasters delivering sky high views and pulse-racing twists, two junior-friendly flat rides deliver excitement for the whole family, and an iconic transport trolley gets your guests from A to B in style. With ready-to-use blueprints and customisation options, you have the freedom to shape unforgettable experiences your way.  

  • HPC - Buzzard: Soar on a thrilling single-rail coaster! Brave guests will experience tight turns, high-speed drops, and heart-pounding inversions in open-air single-seat cars. 

  • V&N – Narrow Drop: Let your guests experience breath-taking views before being plunged down an intense vertical drop they won’t forget. 

  • Jumpin’ Disc: Spin into high-speed excitement! This ride spins around while hydraulic arms bounce riders in chaotic movements, your guests will be feeling intense G-forces and jaw-dropping weightless moments. 

  • Little Dipper: Even the smallest adventurers can enjoy all the fun of a drop tower! Gentle rises and mini drops give younger guests a safe thrill.  

  • Electric Trolley Transport Ride: Let your guests enjoy the sights with a quaint trolley ride around your park inspired by vintage streetcar design. 

Entertainer

Meet Small Town’s cheerful Mayor Pipwhistle, a twirling bundle of whimsy and warm welcomes! With a tip of their hat, confetti showers down on your park's paths, delighting townsfolk and visitors alike. Whether greeting guests at the town square or joining parades, Mayor Pipwhistle brings energy, colour, and a playful sense of joy and wonder to any plaza. 

New Music

It wouldn't be a parade without some exciting music that will keep your guests humming all day - 6 upbeat jazzy music tracks are included in the Parades Pack!
